decisions.label: Wave speed (m/s)
decisions.note: How fast the ley pulse runs to the next stone, metres a second (leyLines.pulseSpeed; 1 as built: Ed, 2026-10-18, "Default starting wave speed is 1m/s, and let me set this from the pause menu"); a wave lands as it reaches its stone, so at 2 they come twice as often. 0 holds the pulse where it is: no waves. Live during a night, remembered on this browser; the boot keeps its own 4 m/s (boot.speed).
